purpose: Compile the two independently screened vector programs into one immutable executable dispatcher whose only program-selection inputs are a compact intervention specification, eliminating counterfactual role-prompt lookup at dispatch time.

prior_art_search.result: The Task14 and bracket artifacts contain fixed vectors and their validation receipts contain dispatch labels, but no combined executable artifact exposes a validated API, exact zero dispatch, or a literal residual dependency boundary.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_exact_compilation: The package contains exactly the ten selected Task14 vectors and six bracket vectors, byte-value equivalent to their source JSON coordinates, with no direction-only controls.
predictions.pred_b_task14_dispatch_complete: All 512 prospective Task14 validation cells dispatch from recipient_number, donor_number, and cardinality to one of the ten licensed vectors; invalid numbers, self-edits, and cardinalities are rejected.
predictions.pred_c_bracket_dispatch_and_zero_complet: All 144 OOD bracket targets dispatch from recipient_closer_id and donor_closer_id to the registered vector, while all 216 answer-preserving controls dispatch exact zero; invalid and self-pairs are rejected.
predictions.pred_d_role_prompt_dependency_eliminated: The dispatcher API and compiled artifact contain no recipient prompt, donor prompt, role prompt, row ID, template, family, activation, logit, or model-object selection input.
predictions.pred_e_residual_boundary_and_price: The selected package stores 18,432 FP32 scalars (73,728 bytes), uses zero model calls to dispatch, and still requires an external intervention specification, a native base activation, and the native downstream suffix/logit path. It is a compiled intervention dispatcher, not an autonomous predictor.

terminal_rule: screen if every immutable compilation, dispatch coverage, zero-dispatch, forbidden-field, price, and residual-boundary gate passes; invalid on hash/schema/source mismatch; null on a valid semantic dispatch failure.
